name: fluid-flow
description: Hydraulic boundary conditions for the fracture-flow / pore-pressure model — fluid flux and sources, plus pore pressure applied to joints via 'block contact apply'.
notes: 'block face apply flux ...' for boundary inflow; 'block gridpoint apply source ...' for point sources.
Both keywords are visible in the live enumerations even WITHOUT 'model configure fluid-flow/matrixflow' (context-free parser; the configure gate is at execution, not keyword visibility).
'block contact apply pore-pressure <f>' sets joint pore pressure for hydro-mechanical coupling.
Live 'block contact apply' enumeration is exactly: pore-pressure range (identical with and without fluid configure).
'block face apply westergaard ...' — live-enumerated on 9.7 (Westergaard hydrodynamic water-pressure distribution); not in the official BC page's keyword list.
